scenarios.name: Throughput plus reflux recovery to spec
scenarios.basis: More flow / More reflux: Reflux cut 1.5 to 1.35 removes purity margin. Fouled trays (efficiency 0.49) forces operator to raise reflux to 1.755 (+30%) to hold spec. At scale 1.1 (=1.32x today, vendor case) internal L/V exceeds Fair flood even with 1.25 factor. Credible operator response between cleanings.

scenarios.name: Low column pressure winter operation
scenarios.basis: Less pressure: Cold seasonal cooling / air-cooler plus pressure-controller offset drops K2750 to 1.05 bar (-30%). Lower pressure raises vapor volumetric rate and jet velocity. Vendor 0.654 run at 1.5 bar not valid. Credible winter utility and PC drift.

scenarios.name: Hot feed with low feed pressure flashing
scenarios.basis: More temperature / Less pressure: Upstream preheat overshoot to 100C (+15C summer / heat-recovery swing) plus suction-strainer fouling dropping FEED to 2.1 bar (-30%) raises inlet vapor fraction flashing into 1.5 bar column, surging stripping vapor. Credible combined heat and pump/feed-filter deviation.

scenarios.name: Light-ends rich feed swing
scenarios.basis: Composition - other than: Upstream fermentation swing to ethanol-rich 0.79 / water-lean 0.21 (-30% water) raises distillate plus rectifying reflux circulation at fixed R=1.35, loading top trays. 10-15% composition swing is credible feed variation claimed as +10% in vendor basis.

scenarios.name: Fouled condenser with reflux creep at target
scenarios.basis: Fouling / More pressure drop: Between cleanings overhead/condenser fouling raises *at N3*/*C2* dP to 0.6331 (+30%) and tray fouling drops efficiency to 0.49. Operator creeps reflux to 1.62 (+20%) to hold purity. Breaks flood even at scale 1.0 target without throughput increase. Credible degraded efficiency.

scenarios.name: Water-rich feed with high tray dP
scenarios.basis: Composition - other than / More pressure drop: Water breakthrough to 0.39 (+30%) / ethanol 0.61 forces higher boilup to meet bottoms spec, loading stripping section and raising column dP to 0.039 (+30%) with liquid holdup. Credible upstream water wash / feed-tank swing.

scenarios.name: Combined modest worst-case
scenarios.basis: More flow / Less pressure / More temperature: Coincident but modest deviations each within normal band: scale 1.1, column 1.2 bar (-20%), feed 95C (+10C), ethanol-rich 0.75/0.25 and reflux 1.5525 (+15% creep) stack vapor/liquid traffic to exceed 0.8 flood, invalidating single-point 0.654 DWSIM claim. Credible HAZOP coincidence.

design: live run 20261104-163619, answer 3: reflux 1.35 + high-capacity trays (capacity factor 1.25, vendor to confirm)
